entities.summary: Robert Enoch Withers was an American physician, Confederate military officer, newspaperman, politician, diplomat, and Freemason. He served as Lieutenant Governor of Virginia and represented Virginia in the United States Senate and served as U.S. Consul in Hong Kong.
